text: Board's updated. Read it. It's not decorative.
Whoever upstairs keeps taking our pallets: they're not furniture. You cannot put a plant on a pallet and call it a "standing desk".

replies.text: ok but hear me out. pallet desks. we sell them. no cap
No.
Wendell, upstairs and downstairs are ONE TEAM :raised_hands: (I have the pallet. It's for my office plant. I'll bring it back)
Bring it back today.

text: Hi warehouse friends! :wave: Reminder that *Feelings & Forklifts* is due by Friday for everyone, yes even upstairs. Module 3 is Safe Spaces, Safe Aisles. It's only 40 minutes and there's a quiz with a fun prize!

replies.text: What's the prize
A certificate! (Laminated, if Lamby holds up :sparkles:)
Lamby won't hold up.

text: Truck from the mill is early. Rosa and Dez on dock 2. Anybody in a tie stay off the dock.
:safety-whistle: Unannounced safety inspection at 11:00. That was the announcement.

replies.text: You can't announce an unannounced inspection, Dale.
Technically it was unannounced until I announced it.
Inspection complete. Findings: one (1) aisle sign is 2 inches too low. One (1) box of Ultra Bright has a dented corner. Big Linda's horn is "unenthusiastic".
Big Linda's horn is fine. You blew your whistle at her for nine minutes.
She needed to hear it.
You also blew it at Rosa.
Rosa was walking briskly. I've made a note in the log. And a note in her favor. Brisk is efficient.
Inspection over. Get off my floor.

text: Also, for anyone on the dock: I have honey for sale. Hurst Family Apiary. Locally sourced, ethically buzzed. :honey-pot-dale: $12 a jar.
Big Linda's back from service. New hydraulics. Rosa put a bow on her. Nobody touch the bow.
reactions: big-linda wendell kip gordon dale nadia

text: BIG LINDA :big-linda: :heart: does she want to be in the Quillies?? "Most Lifting Spirit"?

replies.text: She's a forklift, Gordon.
She's FAMILY Wendell
Fine. But she's not wearing a sash. Sash is a hazard.
Confirmed. Sashes are a snag hazard per section 7.

text: Somebody upstairs labeled a pallet "MINE (GORDON)". It's still our pallet.
Ultra Bright 24 lb restock in. 60 cases. Stacked in aisle 4. Sales, stop telling customers we're out.
Reserving 20 cases for my Thursday account. Don't let Dale near them.

replies.text: There is no reservation system for cases, Priya. I checked the handbook.
There is now. It's called me getting here at 7.
First come first served. Both of you stay out of aisle 4 unless you're wearing a vest.

text: Three of you still haven't started Feelings & Forklifts! I won't say who :slightly_smiling_face: (Wendell, Kip, Gordon)
I've driven a forklift for 22 years. I have feelings about it. Done.
Getting the floor clean for Friday since Denise is walking through. That means upstairs: no "borrowing" the pallet jack for the cake.

replies.text: The cake is on a rolling cart this year. A proper one. With brakes.
I'll inspect the brakes.
Of course you will.

text: Days since last forklift incident: 3. Let's keep it that way through Friday.
Reminder: the dock door closes at 4. If you are on the wrong side of it at 4:01, that is a lesson. :safety-whistle:
Pallet's back. Thanks Gordon. The plant can stay. It's doing better down here anyway.
